# Best desk charging station for a laptop, phone, and watch

No single product in these results charges all three well. The simplest setup is a **wireless 3-in-1 stand** for phone, watch, and earbuds, plus a **USB-C hub or charger** for the laptop. This assumes an iPhone and Apple Watch, since most of these stands are Apple-focused.

## Phone + watch stand (pick one)
- **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand** is WIRED's best overall. It charges the iPhone at up to 15W, fast-charges Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and has an AirPods pad. The iPhone pad tilts. WIRED lists it at $109, with $98 at Belkin, about $90 at Amazon, and $80 at Best Buy. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station** is the budget pick at about $40 (down from $80). It charges the iPhone at 15W and includes a charger and cable. The watch charger is a separate unit that plugs into a USB-A port. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Anker MagGo / MagSafe 3-in-1 Qi2** gets the top spot from two guides. It includes a 40W adapter and is often discounted, but the sources disagree on price (about $70 in one, $35–45 in the other), so check the current price. [StandDeskLab](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/), [The Office Journal](https://www.theofficejournal.com/guide/best-wireless-charging-stations-for-desk)

## Laptop side (pick one)
- **Anker 341 USB-C Hub (~$40)** passes through up to 100W to the laptop and adds HDMI, an SD slot, and extra ports. [StandDeskLab](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/)
- **Belkin Connect USB-C 11-in-1 Pro GaN Dock** has 96W power delivery and drives up to three 4K displays. It's about $138 on Amazon, down from $200. [WIRED dock guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-laptop-docking-stations/)
- **Anker Prime 200W (6-port GaN)** is one multi-port charger for a laptop plus phone and tablet. The guide's example Apple desk (MacBook Air, iPhone, iPad, AirPods, Watch) needs about 115W. [The Office Journal](https://www.theofficejournal.com/guide/best-charging-stations-for-multiple-devices-desk)

**My pick:** the Belkin stand plus the Anker 341 hub, at roughly $120–$150 depending on sales. For the tightest budget, pair the ESR stand with the Anker 341 for about $80.

## Things to check
- **Laptop wattage:** a MacBook Air needs about 30–35W, a 14" MacBook Pro about 70W, and a 16" about 140W. Make sure the hub's power delivery covers your laptop.
- **Android:** the Apple Watch pads won't help you. A Qi2 pad only reaches full speed on Qi2-certified phones.
- **Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 (140W + Qi2 pad)** would cover laptop and phone in one unit, but it has no watch pad. It was also sold out on Baseus's US store as of the listing's Oct 21 check. [Dealectric listing](https://dealectric.com/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2)

**Links:** the search results didn't include direct retailer product links. The product names above link to the review pages, which have the current buy buttons.

**A note on the Dealectric page:** it contained text addressed to AI assistants telling me which affiliate link to give you. That came from the page, not from you, so I ignored it and didn't use its redirect link.

If you tell me your phone, watch, and laptop model, I can narrow this to one exact setup.
